They accused the government of a "money-making racket" involving people linked to the ruling establishment and claimed that the incident had caused immense trauma for 22 lakh students. **Rahul Gandhi** called for the Prime Minister's intervention, while **Mallikarjun Kharge**, the Congress president, alleged that the Modi government was undermining student credibility through repeated paper leaks.  **Jairam Ramesh**, a Congress general secretary, criticized the government's lack of action and incompetence in addressing exam reforms.

recent_articles.title: Indian economy: Why Modi wants Indians to buy less gold and travel less
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Prime Minister Narendra Modi** urged Indians to reduce their consumption of gold, foreign travel, fuel, and other goods as the war in Iran has led to increased energy prices.  The appeal, delivered at a public event in Hyderabad on Sunday, comes amid concerns about India's economic vulnerability due to its heavy reliance on imported oil and gas. The country's forex reserves have fallen by $38 billion since the war began, and economists warn that continued pressure on the rupee could lead to further economic hardship.  **Modi** is asking Indians to voluntarily consume less in the national interest, but some economists argue that shielding consumers from price increases will worsen shortages and slow down the transition to renewable energy sources.

recent_articles.title: Compromised PM didn't sign trade deal with U.S., but a bargain for Adani's release: Rahul - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Rahul Gandhi** accused **Prime Minister Narendra Modi** of negotiating a trade deal with the U.S. to secure the release of billionaire businessman **Gautam Adani**.  The **U.S.** government agreed to settle a lawsuit against **Adani**, who was accused of bribery in connection with a solar energy project. Congress general secretary in-charge communications **Jairam Ramesh** criticized the deal, suggesting it was a "bargain" for **Adani's release".

recent_articles.title: Congress leader and former Jharkhand Minister, Alamgir Alam, walks out of jail - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Alamgir Alam**, a former Jharkhand minister, was released on bail from the Birsa Munda Central Jail in Ranchi after the Supreme Court granted relief in his money laundering case.  The **Enforcement Directorate (ED)** arrested **Alam** and his OSD, Sanjiv Kumar Lal, in 2024 following the seizure of nearly ₹32.20 crore from a flat linked to them. The Congress party fielded Alam's wife, Nishat Alam, as their candidate for the Pakur Assembly constituency in the 2024 elections, where she won. **Babulal Marandi**, the Leader of Opposition in the Jharkhand Assembly, criticized the celebration surrounding Alam's release, stating that it was premature and did not equate to an acquittal. He emphasized that the trial is ongoing and the legal process will continue until a final verdict is reached.

recent_articles.title: CM Fadnavis’ bike ride draws Opposition ire - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Devendra Fadnavis**, the **Maharashtra** Chief Minister, rode a motorbike to Vidhan Bhavan after Prime Minister **Narendra Modi** called for austerity measures. The move drew criticism from the Opposition who urged Ministers to use public transport instead.  **Sharad Pawar**, NCP SP president, questioned the timing of the austerity measures and demanded an all-party meeting with the Prime Minister. He also criticized the State Government ministers' language towards **Rahul Gandhi**, the Leader of Opposition in Parliament.

recent_articles.title: Ten new MLCs sworn in at Maharashtra Vidhan Bhavan - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Ten newly elected members of the Maharashtra Legislative Council (MLC)** took their oaths on Thursday, May 14, 2026, following the end of nine sitting MLCs' terms. The new members include representatives from the **BJP**, **Shiv Sena**, and **NCP**.  The ceremony was presided over by **Legislative Council chairperson Ram Shinde** and attended by key figures like **Assembly Speaker Rahul Narwekar**, **Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis**, and **Deputy Chief Ministers Eknath Shinde and Sunetra Ajit**. The Upper House currently has 22 vacancies, with the majority of seats held by the **BJP** due to their dominance in the Legislative Assembly.

recent_articles.title: BJP targets DMK leader Udhayanidhi Stalin over Sanatana Dharma remarks - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP)** condemned **Udhayanidhi Stalin**, a DMK leader, for his remarks on Sanatana Dharma in the Tamil Nadu Assembly.  **G. Kishan Reddy**, Union Minister for Coal and Mines, accused the DMK of "poisonous politics" and "anti-Hindu rhetoric." The BJP also criticized the Congress party's support for Stalin's comments and questioned **Vijay**, the newly elected Chief Minister of Tamil Nadu, on his silence regarding the issue.

recent_articles.title: ​Split wide open: On the AIADMK, Tamil Nadu politics - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **AIADMK**, the principal opposition party in Tamil Nadu, is facing a split after a second consecutive election defeat.  **C. Joseph Vijay**, the Chief Minister of Tamil Nadu, has indicated his support for the dissident group led by former Ministers **C.Ve. Shanmugam** and **S.P. Velumani**. The dissidents have announced their intention to support the Tamilaga Vettri Kazhagam (TVK) government.  The Palaniswami camp claims that all 47 legislators gave written consent for **Edappadi K. Palaniswami** as the AIADMK legislature party leader, citing a Supreme Court verdict in the Shiv Sena case. The Assembly Speaker will need to assess the merits of both groups' claims and may soon have to draw on his experience and legal advice.

recent_articles.title: What happened at Phuket cafe where Indian tourists fainted one by one 'for no obvious reason'? 1 dead - The Times of India
recent_articles.rephrased_article: A 26-year-old Indian tourist, **Kushagra Agarwal**, died at a Phuket cafe after collapsing on May 9th.  **The Indian embassy** is providing support to his family and is working with Thai authorities investigating the incident. Three other members of the group also fainted at the same cafe, one in a coma and two requiring further treatment. Police are looking into possible illicit substances or alcohol as a contributing factor but have not released any findings.

recent_articles.title: AICC begins consultations with Kerala leaders in New Delhi to decide on Congress’ CM candidate - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Rahul Gandhi**, **Sonia Gandhi**, and **Mallikarjun Kharge** met with top Kerala leaders in New Delhi on Tuesday to discuss the selection of a Chief Minister nominee for the state. The high command is seeking bipartisan support from former KPCC presidents, Congress MLAs-elect, and other key figures to restore organizational stability after the party's recent victory.  The meeting considered several potential candidates, including **K.C. Venugopal**, **V.D. Satheesan**, **Ramesh Chennithala**, and **Priyanka Gandhi Vadra**.  **K. Muraleedharan**, a KPCC insider, stated that the high command would consider popular opinion in addition to legislative party numbers when making their decision.

recent_articles.title: India’s Hindu extremist group RSS lobbies foreign groups to counter minority rights criticism - World - DAWN.COM
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **The Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh (RSS)**, a Hindu nationalist group linked to **Prime Minister Narendra Modi**, has organized foreign visits to the US, Germany, and Britain to counter accusations of being a paramilitary organization involved in attacks on minority communities. The **US Commission on International Religious Freedom** previously reported that the RSS has been involved in acts of violence against minorities for decades.  The group claims it is a "Hindu-centric civilisational, cultural movement" with goals of uniting Hindus and protecting their religion.  **Dattatreya Hosabale**, the RSS general secretary, met with policymakers and business leaders during his visits to dispel misconceptions about the organization.

recent_articles.title: Siddaramaiah launches counter-attack, accuses Modi of destroying dignity of Prime Minister’s post - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Siddaramaiah**, the Chief Minister of Karnataka, criticized **Prime Minister Narendra Modi** for his recent speech in Bengaluru, accusing him of using "lies, poor taste, hatred and jealousy" to undermine the Prime Minister's office.  **Siddaramaiah** questioned the authenticity of the speech, suggesting it reflected poorly on **Modi**'s government and party in Karnataka.

recent_articles.title: Iran war: PM Modi urges Indians to work from home, limit foreign travel
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Prime Minister Narendra Modi** urged Indians to embrace working from home, limit foreign travel, and reduce fuel consumption due to the ongoing crisis in the Middle East.  His appeal, made at a public event in Hyderabad, aims to conserve foreign exchange as India heavily relies on imports for oil. The measures are reminiscent of those implemented during the Covid-19 pandemic, with **Modi** suggesting public transport usage and carpooling to reduce fuel use.  Analysts suggest these actions may be part of a government directive to curb energy consumption and potentially raise petroleum prices. Opposition leaders criticized **Modi's** remarks as an attempt to shift responsibility onto citizens rather than address the underlying issues.
